### How Did God Design the Body of Christ to Work?
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-october-25-2024.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 12:4-7
Points:
- Spiritual gifts are distributed to serve and build up the church rather than for selfish pleasure.
- Believers are responsible for actively studying, stirring up, and developing their gifts.
- When believers collaborate and use their gifts together, the body of Christ grows into mature unity.

### The Sovereign Bestowal of Gifts
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-sovereign-bestowal-of-gifts
Passage: 1 Corinthians 12:8-11
Points:
- The Holy Spirit equips believers with diverse gifts to serve the common good of the church.
- Gifts are distributed entirely according to the sovereign purpose and perfect wisdom of God.
- No individual receives every gift, ensuring that believers depend on one another and avoid envy or isolation.
